question: Guru Pankaj Charan Das and Guru Debaprasad Das are associated with which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Odissi is one of the classical dance forms of India originating from the state of Odisha.
 
• Guru Pankaj Charan Das and Guru Debaprasad Das were pioneering figures in the revival and popularization of Odissi dance in the mid-20th century.
 
• Odissi dance is characterized by its fluid movements, sculpturesque poses, and its emphasis on expressions and gestures (abhinaya).
 
• This dance form is traditionally performed to the classical Odissi music, which is a combination of Hindustani and Carnatic music styles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipuri**

 
 
• Manipuri is a classical dance form from the northeastern state of Manipur.
 
• It is known for its graceful and fluid movements, often depicting the Raas Leela (divine love story of Radha and Krishna).
 
• The dance form incorporates themes from Vaishnavism and regional deities.
 
• Musical accompaniment includes traditional Manipuri instruments like the pung (drum) and pena (string instrument).
 
 
 
• **Kathak**
 
 
• Kathak is one of the major classical dance forms of India, originating from North India.
 
• It is characterized by intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures and storytelling (katha).
 
• Kathak dance has both Hindu and Muslim cultural influences and is performed to Hindustani classical music.
 
• The dance form developed through the courts of the Mughal emperors and the Hindu temples.
 
 
 
• **Kathakali**
 
 
• Kathakali is a traditional dance-drama form from the southwestern state of Kerala.
 
• It is known for its elaborate costumes, detailed makeup, and intricate facial expressions and gestures (mudras).
 
• The themes of Kathakali performances are usually based on Hindu epics such as the Ramayana and Mahabharata.
 
• The musical accompaniment includes traditional Kerala instruments like chenda (drum) and maddalam (drum).
